headline: Silicon Valley Promises AI Will Cure Disease
summary: Drugmaker CEOs remain skeptical about the transformative power of AI in drug discovery, despite significant industry hype and investment.
details: While the tech industry touts Artificial Intelligence as a revolutionary force capable of curing diseases, established pharmaceutical leaders are expressing doubt.
CEOs of major drugmakers, speaking at a recent industry event, indicated that they are not yet convinced AI will fundamentally change drug discovery and development in the near future.
The skepticism highlights a gap between the ambitious claims made by AI proponents and the practical realities faced by those developing life-saving medicines.
caption:
Silicon Valley is betting big on AI to cure diseases, but drugmaker CEOs aren't convinced.

While the tech industry touts Artificial Intelligence as a revolutionary force capable of curing diseases, established pharmaceutical leaders are expressing doubt.

CEOs of major drugmakers, speaking at a recent industry event, indicated that they are not yet convinced AI will fundamentally change drug discovery and development in the near future.

The skepticism highlights a gap between the ambitious claims made by AI proponents and the practical realities faced by those developing life-saving medicines.
